name: copilotas-jam
description: Use your Copilot's LLM as Judge, Advocate, and Mediator. Structured code review, ADR generation, design conflict resolution — all inside Copilot Chat.

chatParticipants.name: judge
chatParticipants.description: Review code against your team's rubric. Returns APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / BLOCK with severity-graded findings.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the active file or selection against the rubric

commands.name: security
commands.description: Run a security audit (OWASP Top-10 focus)

chatParticipants.name: advocate
chatParticipants.description: Generate Architecture Decision Records and stress-test proposals before design reviews.

commands.name: adr
commands.description: Generate an Architecture Decision Record from a proposal

commands.name: devil
commands.description: Devil's Advocate — stress-test a proposal before committing

chatParticipants.name: mediator
chatParticipants.description: Mediate design conflicts between engineers. Finds synthesis, not a winner.

commands.name: design
commands.description: Resolve a design conflict between two positions

chatParticipants.name: codedom
chatParticipants.description: Analyse code structure, find dead code, assess impact, and plan refactors using the Code DOM graph.

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Analyse blast radius of changing a symbol

commands.name: deadcode
commands.description: Find unreachable functions and unused imports

commands.name: refactor
commands.description: Plan a rename refactor across callers
